rps.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
rps.description: Face off against an opponent by guessing the winning hand.

truth-or-dare.title: Truth or Dare
truth-or-dare.description: A wheel picks a player. The other one validates the action or the truth.

odd-or-even.title: Odd or Even
odd-or-even.description: Each player picks a digit and predicts whether the sum will be odd or even.

would-you-rather.title: Would You Rather?
would-you-rather.description: Choose between two fun or surprising dilemmas.

20-questions.title: 20 Questions
20-questions.description: One player thinks of something, the other has 20 tries to guess it.

two-truths-one-lie.title: 2 Truths, 1 Lie
two-truths-one-lie.description: One player states 3 facts, the others vote for the lie.

clair.title: Light
clair.description: A bright, modern palette for lively, fluid sessions.

sombre.title: Dark
sombre.description: A high-contrast, immersive style, perfect for game nights.

luxueux.title: Luxurious
luxueux.description: A polished, premium look for an upscale game experience.

romantique.title: Romantic
romantique.description: A warm, inspiring vibe for cozy game sessions.

home.title: Choose a game and start a match.
home.subtitle: Pick your favorite game, choose Solo or Multiplayer, then join an online room with a unique code.
